title: ProtocolMC Plugins
shortDescription: Custom plugin set that runs protocolmc.net: shared core, scoreboards, lobby gadgets, and a fast schematic builder.
description: Source for the plugins on the ProtocolMC network (Purpur). Includes a shared core library, config-driven scoreboards, placeable lobby gadgets, and BuildX which loads big .yml builds at high block rates. Built for the live servers, not as demos.
highlights: Shared core used by the other plugins
